incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: auth failures detected for tenant 'goldcrest-prod' in private/vpc dedicated pool. HTTP 401 spike on token introspection path. thread_ts=1770055555

elaine (sre): ack. grabbing topology and recent deploys. seeing 401 surge starting ~1770055450, peak error ~18% on auth-mesh. no service deploys reported in last 2h.

elaine (sre): sample error from auth service: 
```
2026-03-20T09:10:12Z introspect error: status=401 msg="introspection failed" detail="tls: certificate has expired"
```

elaine (sre): suggests mTLS handshake failing when our control plane calls customer's JWKS/introspect endpoints. tagging @chris for mTLS/client cert checks.

chris (infra-oncall): running a direct check to jwks.goldcrest.internal, they require client certs. curl with our cert returns: 
```
* Connected to jwks.goldcrest.internal (10.12.45.9) port 443 (#0)
* TLS handshake error: x509: certificate has expired
* curl: (35) error:14094410:SSL routines:ssl3_read_bytes:sslv3 alert certificate expired
```

amir (sec): pulling cert meta from vault for goldcrest-client-cert.

amir (sec): vault entry shows expiry 2026-03-20T09:08:00Z — expired ~2 minutes before incident start. looks like our client cert expired.

nina (acct-eng): pinging customer ops. martin, any recent cert rotations or plans?

martin (customer-oncall): hey, we rotated keys yesterday but we kept the old cert for compatibility, thought Redwood would auto-pull new bundle. our ops confirms new client cert issued but we didn't share the final PEM with Redwood due to an internal gating step. sending now via secure upload.

elaine (sre): short-term mitigation: enabling cached JWKS + raising signature TTL to 5m for goldcrest to reduce 401s. tradeoff: if Goldcrest rotated signing keys we might accept old signatures for a short window. open to risks?

amir (sec): acceptable for 10m emergency window with audit logging and customer sign-off.

chris (infra-oncall): adding temporary ingress rule to their introspect endpoint to allow control plane IPs to skip mTLS for 10m (bypass). will log and auto-revoke.

deploy-bot: TRACE: bypass-rule applied by chris at 2026-03-20T09:12:30Z for goldcrest (10m). rule_id=rb-8811

elaine (sre): error rate dropped from 18% -> 2.3% after cache+bypass. still seeing some 401s from older sessions. working with martin to get cert.

martin (customer-oncall): uploaded cert and key to secure drop at 2026-03-20T09:14:05Z. also posted SSO ticket with manifest.

chris (infra-oncall): pulling cert into private control plane and rotating connector cert: 
```bash
redwoodctl private cert upload --team goldcrest --cert /tmp/gc-client.pem --key /tmp/gc-client.key
redwoodctl private cert rotate --connector goldcrest-introspect
```

chris (infra-oncall): rotation kicked off at 2026-03-20T09:16:20Z. restarting connector service.

deploy-bot: INFO: cert-rotation job goldcrest-introspect completed (exit=0) at 2026-03-20T09:17:01Z

chris (infra-oncall): post-rotation healthcheck: 
```
$ curl --cert /etc/redwood/certs/goldcrest-client.pem --key /etc/redwood/keys/goldcrest-client.key https://jwks.goldcrest.internal/.well-known/jwks.json
* TLSv1.3 (IN), TLS handshake, Finished
* HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{ "keys": [ ... ] }
```

elaine (sre): monitoring metrics: auth 401s back to baseline. will keep enhanced logging for 30m.

amir (sec): documenting audit trail: expired cert at 09:08Z, bypass window 09:12:30Z-09:22:30Z, cert rotation completed 09:17:01Z. recommend follow-ups: 1) proactive expiry alerts for customer client certs (owner: chris), 2) update onboarding runbook to require cert upload TTL>=30d (owner: nina), 3) add auto-notify to customer 14d/7d/1d before client cert expiry (owner: acct-eng).

nina (acct-eng): filing customer impact note: Goldcrest experienced auth failures starting ~09:08Z, peak error rate ~18%, mitigated via temporary bypass and cert rotation, full restore confirmed 09:17Z. sending to account team and ops.

martin (customer-oncall): thanks team. we'll update our change gating so final push to Redwood happens before cutover.

elaine (sre): marking incident mitigated. scheduling 30m post-incident sync to write up timeline and assign owners. closing thread — postmortem to be filed in /postmortems/goldcrest-mtls-expiry.

incident-bot: INCIDENT MITIGATED for goldcrest-prod (status=resolved) at 2026-03-20T09:31:51Z
